pass_condition: Independently review the model proof and known design-curve comparator. Acquire a same-species nonzero differential Stark-vector norm and Lorentzian decay parameter in the actual weak-transfer regime; then calibrate a three-axis finite-bandwidth field and compare initial leakage against equally prepared static and strongest admissible control under matched RMS, peak, bandwidth and delivery energy. Rotation, multiple channel norms, competing resonances, damage, preparation, lifetime and chemical yield remain separate gates.
